verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs say users can be notified via Webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold (alerts), and spend-threshold alerts are also mentioned. That is a first-party outbound webhook capability, but it is scoped to metric alerts rather than general event subscriptions, and only a single line documents it. missing for 10: subscriptions to broader event types (e.g. trace created, score added, prompt version changed), documentation of webhook registration, payloads and retries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
